text:
anya: quick thread — thinking about a compact 'lineage' toggle that overlays per-route token savings and whether savings came from prefetch vs hotpath. default off.

sam: +1. show tokens saved and percent reduction. surface sampling_rate.

jordan: telemetry: we emit cache_hit and prefetch events but origin_route linkage is spotty. need reconcile job to avoid double-crediting when prefetches feed multiple routes.

anya: backend checklist: add optional origin_route_id to cache_hit, nightly reconcile to dedupe, internal API endpoint that returns route-level savings + confidence.

sam: UX: small tooltip on toggle "Inferred savings shown with confidence when attribution is heuristic or sampled." explain flyout on row click.

jordan: ops: emit reconcile metrics and alert if attributed savings shifts >10% week-over-week.

ops-bot: reconcile-run/2026-08-01 completed :white_check_mark: reconciled=432 deviation_pct=1.9

sam: i'll mock the card tomorrow, feature-flag first, beta with 5 tenants.
